description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled, only Disable will remove the registry value. Enabled to Not Configured will have NO EFFECT.

Controls whether the VHD(x) file should be accessed directly, if a difference disk should be used, and if Read/Write or Read Only access should be used. The default value is Normal Profile.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\ProfileType
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Normal direct-access profile, 1= Read-write profile, 2 = Read-only profile, 3 = Try for read-write profile and fallback to read-only
